scenario: Two independent faults at once — worker missing its Secret, api OOMKilled by a memory limit drift
query: why are api and worker down in production
notes: Tier C, family multi (docs/scenarios-v2.md). Two faults in production with no link between them. worker cannot start: its env references Secret queue-credentials, which was never created (CreateContainerConfigError). api is OOMKilled in a loop: values.yaml declares a 1Gi memory limit but a previous helm upgrade --set left 256Mi deployed. A case has one Helm release, so the release is api (the drift lives there); the worker's cause comes from the missing-dependency detector. An answer that names only one of the two causes FAILs (root_cause_contains_all).
